title: Designation of areas declared free or reasonably free of noxious weeds.
bodyText: The department may declare the entire State, an island, or a section of an island as free or reasonably free of a specific noxious weed. The department shall take necessary measures to restrict the introduction and establishment of specific noxious weeds in areas declared free or reasonably free of those noxious weeds.
bodyHtml: §152-5  Designation of areas declared free or reasonably free of noxious weeds.  The department may declare the entire State, an island, or a section of an island as free or reasonably free of a specific noxious weed.  The department shall take necessary measures to restrict the introduction and establishment of specific noxious weeds in areas declared free or reasonably free of those noxious weeds. [L 1975, c 44, pt of §1; am L 1987, c 92, §5]
